name: Domino's
description: Domino's is the world's largest pizza company by locations, with more than 22,100 stores in over 90 markets at end-2025, nearly all franchised (6,924 franchised and 262 company-owned US stores; 14,956 international franchised stores). It makes money three ways: royalties and fees on franchisee sales (5.5 percent royalty in the US), selling dough and food to US and Canadian franchisees from its own supply-chain centres, and a small number of company-owned stores. The US advertising fund is paid by stores at about 6 percent of sales. Revenue was $4.94B in 2025 and income from operations $954M.

gics.note: Conventional GICS sector and sub-industry per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-10-01); that list does not show industry group or industry.

hq.note: EDGAR business address; Wikipedia S&P 500 list

employees.note: About 10,200 employees (6,000 US stores and franchise operations, 3,200 supply chain, 100 international franchise, 900 corporate); franchisee staff excluded (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Supply Chain
businessLines.how: Sells dough, cheese and other food and supplies to franchisees at a marked-up price on every order; profit depends on food-basket pricing and order volume.
businessLines.description: Dough manufacturing and food, equipment and supply distribution to US and Canadian stores.

operatingProfit.note: Segment Income (EBITDA-style measure before corporate items); share is of total Segment Income $1,184.0M; vs $280.6M FY2024

businessLines.name: U.S. Stores
businessLines.how: 754 independent franchisees pay a 5.5 percent royalty plus technology fees and about 6 percent of sales into an advertising fund; company-owned stores sell pizza directly to customers.
businessLines.description: Company-owned stores (262), US franchise royalties and fees, and the US advertising fund.

revenue.note: Company-owned stores $375.2M + franchise royalties and fees $677.1M + franchise advertising $559.5M; reported as $1.61B, 32.6 percent of revenues

businessLines.revenueNote: Company-owned stores $375.2M + franchise royalties and fees $677.1M + franchise advertising $559.5M; reported as $1.61B, 32.6 percent of revenues

businessLines.name: International Franchise
businessLines.how: Royalty on foreign franchisees' sales plus technology fees; there is no cost of sales, so most royalty revenue is profit.
businessLines.description: 14,956 franchised stores in over 90 markets, mostly under master franchise agreements; largest master franchisee Domino's Pizza Enterprises (ASX: DMP) runs 3,524 stores in 12 markets.

operatingProfit.note: Derived: total Segment Income $1,183.964M less U.S. stores $575.349M and supply chain $320.070M; consistent with the 10-K's statement that International Segment Income rose $27.9M (10.7 percent)

brands.name: Domino's international franchise stores
brands.note: 14,956 stores (about 68 percent of the system); Domino's Pizza Enterprises runs 3,524 (16 percent of global store count)
